name: matlab-plot-skill
description: Create, clean up, and export publication-quality MATLAB figures for papers, LaTeX or Overleaf, and Beamer slides: run MATLAB, read the rendered figure, and iterate until the layout is clean.

interface.shortDescription: Create or fix MATLAB figures and export clean PDF plots
interface.longDescription: Build new MATLAB figures or clean up messy ones for papers, LaTeX or Overleaf, and Beamer slides. The agent runs MATLAB, exports a vector PDF plus a PNG preview, reads the rendered figure, and iterates until the layout is clean.
defaultPrompt: Use matlab-plot-skill to clean up this MATLAB figure and export a vector PDF for my paper.
Use matlab-plot-skill to turn these subplots into a tiledlayout figure with one shared legend.
Use matlab-plot-skill to resize this MATLAB figure for a Beamer slide and check the rendered PNG.
